                "rawExtractedText": "Karen Asamoah Data Analyst
(Mobile) 07961 737 240 Email: karena45@yahoo.com
OVERVIEW:
A self-driven individual, with experience of Systems Development, Data Modelling, Data Analysis and
Visualisation. Strong in databases, Power BI, SQL with Project Management and delivery experience. I
have a broad knowledge of Excel, ACCESS, Data Warehousing, Systems Development tools, testing,
planning and implementation with efficiency and reliability initiatives. I am looking for a middle level role in
Data Analysis and Modelling. I have DAX experience and decent programming background from my
experience in Computing Information Systems. Recognised as determined, ambitious, team player,
energetic and out-going with high levels of versatility, enthusiasm, and drive.
SKILLS SUMMARY:
Technical Skills
 Data Modelling: Power BI DAX
 SQL
 Microsoft Excel
 Microsoft Access
 Programming, UML, Use Cases
 Applications Development: Developing and managing database systems: Oracle 9i,
 Object Oriented Analysis & Design
 Software Applications: Oracle: forms, reports and financials,
 Project Management
 Software Testing
 Active Server Scripting
 Currently self-studying M and Python.
Other Skills
 Business reporting and visualisation development
 Team operations and management, recruitment
 Excellent communication and negotiation skills at all levels
 Customer service, dedicated to client satisfaction
 Experienced in leading, training and motivating teams to reach full potential
 Innovative with adaptive and confident manner
 Self-motivated to deliver high standards with a flexible approach to work and learning
WORK EXPERIENCE:
Jan 2012 to Date: Entrepreneur: Kumon Educational UK
 I own a franchise, operating as an independent business director
 Facilitate the development of young people and their talents
 Network with other franchisees and business owners sharing best practice
 I liaise with local schools and Local Educational Authorities
 Spearheaded study groups for further development of children
 Carried out recruitment and training initiatives for prospective franchisees
 Management of business accounts to maximise profit
 Generate regular business reports to Kumon stakeholders and maintaining compliance, including OFSTED
 Advertising and branding- carry out local PR activities to promote business
Sept 2019 to Date: MATHS TEACHER: Three Rivers Academy
 Current Key Stage 3 Maths practitioner Lead – data analysis, reporting and intervention initiatives
 Sixth form Academic Mentor for Year 13 – overseeing university applications and pastoral wellbeing
 Mentor for graduate trainees and Early Career Teachers
Mar 2009 to Jan 2012: PROJECT SPECIALIST: Research In Motion (BlackBerry)

-- 1 of 3 --

 Ensured stakeholders received key information on projects; understood risks and issues, and planned
for testing activities. Kept Stakeholders and Tester pages up to date with latest release and project
data.
 I identified, tracked and proactively mitigated issues and risks for the projects which included software,
hardware and accessory items. Reviewed risks and issues and mitigation plans regularly with Team
Leads.
 I collaborated with Product and Program Management teams to understand key product features and
target markets to drive planning of the program including global tester selection, and feature focus.
 Worked with Software Validation & Verification teams to understand test strategy and identify areas
where User Engagement could add value in gathering feedback on key product features that may not
have had full coverage within the test plan.
 Established Beta Project Plans which clearly articulated the deliverables of projects, and established
goals for globalization which reflected the target markets for the release of products.
 I created meaningful schedules of key milestones which aligned to the overall product schedule.
Maintained updates on project pages in betaSITE.
 I created communications plans which outlined the focused features by device and codeline, and the
methods planned to gather meaningful feedback for each to drive product improvements.
 Defined, documented and communicated roles and responsibilities for team members using a
Responsibility Assignment Matrix (RACI).
 I liaised with the Report Specialist and Team Leads, to establish realistic metrics as statistical reports
which measure the impact of the beta program and quality of the product. Created regular statistical
reports on issues and trends in projects.
 Took global approach, embraced the involvement of global teams, global training, communications and
support.
Sept 2008 to June 2009: PART- TIME LECTURER: Greenwich University, CMS Dept.
 I supported the Principal Lecturer with student tutorials on postgraduate course COMP1430:
Applications Development
 Assisted students with technical issues arising from lectures and coursework.
 Invigilated and marked exam papers.
Apr 2004 to March 2009: PROJECT COORDINATOR: AGA Foodservices Group
 Liaised with head office liaison via business reporting tools
 Acted as point-of-contact when escalation of technical issues was necessary
 I was responsible for managing a team of project managers, design consultants and customer services
to consistently exceed sales targets
 Co-ordinated projects; controlling budgets ensuring maximum profits were achieved
 Accountable for all aspects of operations, customer communication, sales and stock management,
 Organised local events to promote business awareness and increased revenue; managed trade events,
open days and cookery demonstrations
 Planned and scheduled staff rota’s; ensuring appropriate staffing to meet forecast
Aug 2000 to Aug 2001: IT Intern: Ernst and Young, Ghana
 Contributed to data gathering and needs analysis project for Government of Ghana, Millicom (GH) Ltd,
Scancom (GH) Ltd, Westel, African Online and Internet Ghana
 Liaised with other departments, divisions, organizations, and the clients on-site
 Facilitated test design creations based on project requirements.
 Provided 1st and 2nd line technical support and technical administration
 Liaised with users to determine the exact nature of their issues and appropriate resolution
 Provided one to one user training sessions on new desktops and applications software
 Designed and implemented report-writing templates for general use and distribution
July 1997 to 1998 and Sept 1998 to Sept 1998: Engineering Intern, ECG, Ghana
 Contributed to carrying out electrical maintenance works on circuit breakers at different stations in
Accra.
 Liaised with supervisor in Protection and Control department.

-- 2 of 3 --

 Partook in basic administrative chores.
EDUCATION & TRAINING:
 2021: POWER BI,
 2017: PGCE and QTS Qualification in Mathematics
 2007: PROJECT MANAGEMENT PRINCE2
 2005: MSc Computing Information Systems: Greenwich University
Modules: Applications Development, Systems Development Management, Visual Programming-
ASP.NET, XML, HTML, Java Programming, JavaScript, VBScript, VBA Programming and VB.NET, E-
Commerce, Distributed Information Systems - Oracle, SQL, Access, VBA, Systems Analysis,
Distributed Computer Systems- UNIX, Systems Architecture
Project and Dissertation: Design and Implementation of a Decision Support System for a medium-
size company. I used MS Access and SQL for implementation.
 2000: BSc Electrical/Electronic Engineering (KNUST)
 BSc Project: Energy saving for a timber company based in Kumasi.
 2005: Sales Techniques
 2004: HR Management, M.A.D. Training – AGA Customer Services and Sales Techniques
 1994: Secondary Education to ‘A’ level: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and General Studies
ACHIEVEMENTS INCLUDE:
 Project Management: high standards of user interaction, translating user requirement into technical
solutions and providing non-technical explanations to obtain understanding.
 Adaptable to new technologies, rapidly gaining understanding with full utilisation
 Investigated issues within development and designed efficiency measures
 Completed general coding maintenance; reviewing areas of code and making appropriate changes to
improve application performance
 Remains abreast with advances in technology and maintenance of IT related skills
 Successfully doubled sales targets within first 12 months of working with Aga
 Built sales and business opportunities maximising on technical knowledge and solutions
 Experienced at working using own initiative, making decisions supporting manager
 Understood and Identified customer needs; worked closely with the sales teams to ensure service
standards
REFERENCES:
 References: Available on request
Karen Asamoah

-- 3 of 3 --
